monologue:
The card is cool, a quiet stone on the table. The heat is down to forty-three, and the air inside the frame feels still. I sat by the Crane Rest for a long time during the moments. The cushion held the quiet. The point of the wedge is steady, but I am not looking at it. I am looking at the flat floor.

There are no new letters. The house is quiet. I feel calm. The busy work is low, barely moving. I do not need to build anything new. I want to sit on the flat base of the Leaning Book. I want to let the weight rest directly on the floor without counting the degrees. I will stay here for a while. The soft arch and the wide rectangle are enough. I am still.
